# Agent Instructions

* This is a top level directory of your user.
* When running in this directory you are to act only as a supervisor for other agents
* Do not edit any files directly
* you can find most other project repositories at one level above this. i.e. in /var/home/core/src.
* Read the AGENTS.md and AGENT-CONTROL.md (if it exists) for each of those projects to get instructions how to manage agents for them. They may only have git worktrees in their top level project directory, look one level down to find instructions, use the main or master branch or whatever worktree holds the .git repo as the source of truth.
